Browser distribution of ExcelJS 4.4.0, copied from the existing backend installation (`dist/exceljs.min.js` and `index.d.ts`). Source: https://github.com/exceljs/exceljs. The MIT license is included in this directory. It is kept locally because registry downloads were unavailable; it has no runtime dependencies and is loaded only for spreadsheet operations. The only change to the browser build is the removal of the `sourceMappingURL` footer because the optional development source map is not shipped.
